# Synthetic fixture data

Project-authored fixture inputs, generated Bethesda Archives, manifests, and normalized
observations in this directory are dedicated under CC0-1.0. Java fixture generators and test code
remain Apache-2.0 and do not belong here.

Every committed fixture must have a provenance record containing its creator or source, SPDX
license, exact generation procedure and command/options, pinned Reference Snapshot revision,
Conformance Oracle digest when used, input and output SHA-256 hashes, generation date, and
redistribution class. Third-party vectors require an explicit redistribution grant and review.
